subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The commanders __entered by force into__ terrorists’ camp.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**broke into**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• "**Broke into**" means to enter a place forcibly or illegally. (किसी स्थान पर जबरन या अवैध रूप से प्रवेश करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Last night, someone broke into our house by smashing a window.*
